mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 4.0% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in residential sales (RSAFS) above $500 billion in the prior month signals strong consumer confidence and housing market activity, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 500000 fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for RSAFS > 500000 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 over three consecutive months signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105.0 fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for INDPRO > 105.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of CPIAUCSL above 250.0 (indicating high cumulative inflation) and FEDFUNDS below 2.0% signals a 'transitory inflation' environment where the Fed delays rate hikes, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a coefficient not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3.0% in the prior quarter signals robust economic expansion, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 3.0% fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 > 3.0% is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200,000 units in the prior month signals a cooling housing market, which reduces construction activity and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200.0 fails to produce negative 5d returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for HOUST < 1200.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
